text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days before Nice Nature's mother was due to visit,
I decided to make a suggestion after our outing.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try entering the next mock race?
Want to try entering the next mock race?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Did you say Mayano's running next?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's the day Nature's mom is coming, after all.
Yeah, and it's the day Nature's mom is coming to visit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We might as well let them see you race.
With how you're doing right now, we can aim for first place," they continued.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
Not like you're gonna take "no" for an answer anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll enter the race for you since it can't be helped.
Though I don't know if I can beat Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later.
Just before the mock race began—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Both Mom and Trainer are waving at me at the same time... It's totally like a parent's observation day at school.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Guess I can't go
looking uncool, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hehe~♪
Maya's gonna win today's race too~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Just as expected, Mayano dashed out from the start.
Running as a front-runner was within predictions, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as planned in their pre-race meeting,
Nice Nature has Mayano Top Gun closely marked.
choice_data_list: Still, is it just me, or does the pace feel a bit fast?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Just about time.
—Maya-chin, take off!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(No way, she's accelerating here?! So she was planning
to run as a front-runner from the start, not a stalker...?!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Aargh! This is completely unexpected!
If she goes all the way like this... will I lose!?)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Kh, dammiiiiiiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature dashed out in pursuit of Mayano Top Gun,
but that threw off her pacing—and she finished in 3rd place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, Nice Nature's mother seemed to clearly recognize her daughter's growth and looked overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A good while had passed since the mock race ended,
and yet, no matter where I looked,
Nice Nature was nowhere to be found.
choice_data_list: Assuming your mother waits for us at the cafe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've searched the whole campus, so should I look outside?
Nice Nature's mom said that when she was down in the dumps as a kid,
she'd mope by the riverbed all by herself, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer-san...
Have you been looking for me this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, kinda sorry about that, huh? Finished 3rd in the race,
so in the end, it was just your usual Nature-san, ahaha!
choice_data_list: That's true.
You don't have to force yourself to smile.
You don't have to force yourself to smile.
Alright! Let's go get a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, kinda sorry about that, huh? Finished 3rd in the race,
so in the end, it was just your usual Nature-san, ahaha!
choice_data_list: That's true.
You don't have to force yourself to smile.
You don't have to force yourself to smile.
Alright! Let's go get a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: You were the same hardworking, wonderful Nature as always.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: People talk about 'trying your hardest', but no matter how hard you try, it's meaningless if you don't win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win this race...
I HAD to win it, dammit!!
choice_data_list: But your mom seemed happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her that her feelings had
truly reached them—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even so...
Even so, it still... really frustrated me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I've cried my eyes out.
It's embarrassing at my age, honestly.
choice_data_list: You really could let yourself lean on me more, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I got plenty of pampering, so I'm good!
Come on, let's head back to my mom's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Nice Nature, who had regained her energy,
we returned to where her mother was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking to her mother, Nice Nature wore
a shy yet genuinely happy smile.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's not like I'm pushing myself—
choice_data_list: It's frustrating, and I really wanted you to win.
I'm frustrated, and I wanted you to win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I got all carried away
thinking I'd caught up to Mayano during our last training match."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I brushed off Mayano's words when she said, "I realize just how amazing Nature-chan is right now."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, Mayano really is amazing.
She figures out so many things—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, you probably have no idea
how much I'm suffering like this, do you?
choice_data_list: Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I do like her, you know?
The one I hate is myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'm narrow-minded, there's so much I don't understand...
I'm just a hopelessly ordinary person..."
choice_data_list: Even so, I think that's fine.
I think that's fine too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I told her that if there's anything she doesn't understand,
we can think through it together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And if you still can't figure it out...?
choice_data_list: Shall the two of us mope around here together?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft!
Ahaha, what's that even mean?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A short while after that—I returned to where a rejuvenated Nice Nature and her mother were waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking to her mother, Nice Nature wore
a shy yet genuinely happy smile.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pardon?
Where are we going for a change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a bewildered Nice Nature along with me,
I headed toward the now-familiar shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you plan to do with Nature-san
after bringing her all the way out here?
choice_data_list: Nothing beats eating when you're feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, I bought some
taiyaki they were selling at the shop."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki, huh...
choice_data_list: Was that not your strong suit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No. I was just remembering how, back when I was feeling down, Mom bought me taiyaki too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're both so meddlesome... Both Mom and you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: That's just how worried Nature is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Worried, huh...
I feel bad for causing my mom trouble too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I'll buy some taiyaki to bring
as a token of apology."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, bag of taiyaki in hand,
I returned to Nice Nature and her mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking to her mother, Nice Nature wore
a shy yet genuinely happy smile.
